comment: Same graph shape and token as topo-fanout-fanin-declared-order, but C is declared before B, so the declaration-order tie-break (SPEC §7.4) fixes the log as A, C, B, D instead of A, B, C, D. Per-gate verdicts and the master decision are unchanged; only the evaluation order (and so the log) differs, which is exactly what the declaration-order rule predicts.
